question: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of any state in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mrs. Sucheta Kriplani.__

__
 
• Mrs. Sucheta Kripalani was India's first woman Chief Minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• According to **Article 164 **of the Indian Constitution**, the Chief Minister shall be appointed by the governor.**
 
• In the history of independent India, the **first woman Chief Minister** was **Sucheta Kriplani **of the Indian National Congress (INC).
 
• In **October 1963**, she became the **Chief Minister o**f **Uttar Pradesh**, the first woman to hold that position in any Indian state.
 
• He serves as the head of the Uttar Pradesh government from 1963 to 1
